name: DNA double-strand break and interstrand crosslink repair
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, HR/BRCA1-2/PALB2, NHEJ, SSA/MMEJ, Fanconi crosslink repair, fork reversal, PARylation and genotoxic drug responses, unlike the broader repair confusable that adds excision, mismatch and translesion repair or the telomere-maintenance confusables.

name: Chemokine receptor signaling in dendritic cell migration
rationale: All members concern chemokine-receptor-driven chemotaxis, and the CCR7, dendritic cell chemotaxis, maturation and survival members distinguish it from the monocyte, T cell and lymphocyte-homing chemokine confusables.

name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction
rationale: All three members describe IRF3-driven activation of type I IFN, whereas confusables are defined by upstream RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING or TLR sensing.

name: Vitamin K-dependent protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin K response and the carboxylation, ER-Golgi transport and propeptide removal of gamma-carboxylated precursors, not the coagulation cascade or other vitamin metabolism of the confusables.

name: Arterial endothelial differentiation in dorsal aorta formation
rationale: Members are arterial/endothelial cell differentiation and dorsal aorta morphogenesis, distinct from the cardiac outflow, valve, endocardium and coronary confusables.

name: Striated muscle adaptation to activity and inactivity
rationale: Members concern muscle adaptation, fiber-type switching, atrophy, response to activity/inactivity and growth, distinct from myogenic development and calcineurin-driven hypertrophy confusables.

name: Hedgehog signal transduction through SMO and GLI
rationale: All members are Hedgehog pathway steps (SMO activation, ciliary localization, GLI processing/degradation and transcription), unlike confusables on Hh ligand lipidation or neural plate and planar polarity development.

name: Sphingomyelin biosynthesis and amyloid precursor protein regulation
rationale: Members combine de novo sphingolipid/sphingomyelin synthesis and homeostasis with regulation of amide metabolism and APP synthesis and catabolism, which the sphingolipid catabolism and amyloid fibril confusables lack in combination.

name: NADPH-dependent ROS and reactive aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate, methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and oxidized protein repair, distinct from the glutathione-synthesis, ferroptosis and vitamin confusables.

core: Inflammatory and extrinsic programmed cell death
name: Death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and non-NLRP3 inflammasome pyroptosis
rationale: Members span FAS/TRAIL/caspase-8 apoptosis, RIPK necroptosis and AIM2/NLRP1/IPAF/CASP4/5 pyroptosis with IL-18, distinguished from the NLRP3/IL-1 confusables and the mitochondrial apoptosis confusable.

name: Pancreatic progenitor and neuroendocrine cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover pancreatic multipotent and NEUROG3+ progenitors, alpha-cell and exocrine development, neuroendocrine and adrenal differentiation, unlike the endoderm specification and gastrulation confusables.

name: NK receptor and T cell cytotoxicity and tolerance regulation
rationale: Members concern NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation, MHC presentation and tolerance/anergy, with NK receptor and KIR modules distinguishing it from DC, Th1/Treg and T cell signaling confusables.

name: Fatty acid elongation and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are synthetic: very-long-chain and PUFA (LA/ALA) acyl-CoA elongation plus plasmalogen, ether and wax synthesis, as opposed to the peroxisomal oxidation, import and cholesterol synthesis confusables.

qualifier: LXR regulation and foam cell suppression
name: LXR-regulated cholesterol efflux and foam cell suppression
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse cholesterol transport, HDL clearance, cholesterol storage and foam cell formation, including LXR targets, distinct from HDL assembly/remodeling and cholesterol import confusables.

name: Phospholipid scrambling and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members cover aminophospholipid translocation, Ca-activated scrambling, PS exposure, blebbing and apoptotic cell recognition/engulfment, unlike the flippase, foam cell or surfactant confusables.

name: Cysteinyl leukotriene and prostanoid receptor signaling
rationale: Members are leukotriene D4 synthesis, transport and CysLT receptor signaling plus prostanoid GPCRs, distinguished from prostaglandin synthesis, histamine and lipoxin/LTB4 catabolism confusables.

name: Proximal TCR-CD3 signaling in T cell activation
rationale: Members are T cell activation modules plus CD3/zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70 synapse recruitment and ITK/PKC differentiation, distinct from CD28 costimulation, downstream TCR and thymocyte development confusables.

name: Leading-edge ruffling, podosome assembly and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members regulate actin-driven ruffles, lamellipodia, pseudopodia, podosomes and macropinocytosis at the leading edge, which the Arp2/3, CDC42/IQGAP and actin network confusables lack.

name: Circadian nuclear receptor control of metabolism and beta cells
rationale: Members link BMAL1/CLOCK/NPAS and ROR/REV-ERB clock transcription with PPARA, PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis, thermogenesis and beta-cell growth, beyond the core CRY/PER clock and gluconeogenesis or adipogenesis confusables.

name: Cardiac contractility and relaxation via SERCA calcium reuptake
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation together with SR calcium import and ATPase activity, unlike confusables on cardiac adaptation or sequestered calcium release and membrane potential.

name: TLR adaptor and NIK-dependent NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members are IKK/TAK1 activation downstream of TLR/TRIF/IRAK adaptors plus NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kB and IKK deficiencies, distinct from the TNFR1 and lymphocyte NF-kB confusables.

name: Poly-ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodeling at DNA damage
rationale: Members concern PARylation, nucleosome assembly/remodeling (CHD1/2), chromatin protein recruitment and fork/R-loop processing, without the DSB repair pathways or telomere maintenance of the confusables.

name: Platelet agonist GPCR signaling through G12/13 and Rho
rationale: Members are thrombin PAR, thromboxane, prostacyclin and ADP P2Y receptor signaling with G12/13 and Rho activation, distinct from collagen/GPVI, VWF adhesion and degranulation confusables.

name: Gonadotropin and GnRH hormone-receptor signaling
rationale: Members are cellular responses to GnRH, FSH and LH and glycoprotein hormone receptor binding, unlike confusables on gonad development, activin and gonadotropin secretion.

name: Iron homeostasis and heavy metal response via BACH1-HMOX1
rationale: Members cover iron import and homeostasis, responses to cobalt, lead and selenium, and BACH1/HMOX1 regulation, distinguished from zinc/copper/cadmium transport and heme scavenging confusables.
